text: For 2026-08-01 to 2026-08-31, using the defaults that “units sold” means units_sold, UK means United Kingdom, and reporting currency is GBP, the top 5 showrooms were Kestrel Birmingham East with 1107, Kestrel Liverpool South with 983, Kestrel Manchester Riverside with 913, Kestrel Leicester Lakeside with 746, and Kestrel London City Centre with 742 units sold.
